title: ExtractionResult
description: Structured output returned by the ReceiptExtractor.extract() interface. This is the raw provider response after transport parsing. It is validated against this schema before any field is persisted to receipt_revisions or line_item_revisions. Model output that does not conform is stored as-is in extraction_runs.raw_response with status 'invalid' and never promoted to a current revision (VAL-001, AI-03).

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must match the extraction_runs.schema_version recorded per run. Version mismatch causes terminal failure.

merchant_raw.description: Merchant name exactly as extracted from the evidence. Source text; never normalized here.

merchant_normalized.description: Extractor's suggested normalized merchant name. Non-authoritative; subject to human correction. Stored as normalized field in receipt_revisions.

purchase_date.description: Purchase date as found on the receipt in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Do not invent a date when not evidenced.

purchase_time.description: Purchase time as found on the receipt in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format (24-hour). Do not invent when not evidenced.

purchase_timezone.description: IANA timezone name or UTC offset when explicitly stated on the receipt. Do not infer from capture location or merchant geography.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Required; default to 'USD' only when the currency is clearly implied by the evidence and no other currency is present. Never guess.

subtotal_minor.description: Pre-tax, pre-tip receipt subtotal in minor currency units (e.g., cents for USD). Must be a non-negative integer. Null when not evidenced.

tax_minor.description: Total tax in minor currency units. Null when not evidenced.

tip_minor.description: Tip or gratuity in minor currency units. Null when not evidenced.

discount_minor.description: Total discount as a positive magnitude in minor currency units. Null when not evidenced. Stored as positive; deterministic validation applies sign convention.

total_minor.description: Grand total in minor currency units. Null when not evidenced. Deterministic validation checks: subtotal + tax + tip - discount ≈ total (within rounding tolerance).

payment_method_hint.description: Redacted payment method hint (e.g., 'Visa •••• 1234'). Must never contain full card numbers, account numbers, or CVV. Stored as a hint only.

overall_confidence.description: Provider or derived overall confidence score for this extraction. Definition varies by provider and prompt version; recorded alongside provider and model ID for interpretability.

line_items.description: Ordered line items extracted from the receipt. Null when no line items are evidenced. Empty array means the receipt had no itemized lines.

provider_notes.description: Non-financial notes from the provider about extraction quality or ambiguities (e.g., 'Image partially obscured'). Safe to store; must not contain credentials, URLs, or instructions.

LineItem.description: One line item extracted from the receipt. ordinal reflects evidence order (1-based).

ordinal.description: 1-based position in evidence order. Must be unique within this extraction result.

raw_description.description: Extracted description exactly as it appears on the receipt. Required.

normalized_description.description: Extractor's suggested normalized product/service name. Non-authoritative.

quantity.description: Quantity as a decimal string to avoid floating-point loss (e.g., '2', '1.5', '0.75'). Null when not evidenced.

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g., 'lb', 'oz', 'each', 'fl oz'). Null when not stated.

unit_price_decimal.description: Unit price as a decimal string when precision exceeds minor units (e.g., '3.99', '0.499'). Null when not evidenced.

line_total_minor.description: Authoritative line total candidate in minor currency units. Null when not evidenced. Deterministic validation checks consistency with quantity × unit_price when both are present.

discount_minor.description: Line-level discount as a positive magnitude in minor currency units. Null when not evidenced.

category_suggestion.description: Non-authoritative category suggestion constrained to a versioned vocabulary defined in the extraction prompt. Never treated as a canonical fact. Stored in line_item_revisions.category_suggestion.

field_confidence.description: Named per-field confidence scores or quality signals. Keys are field names from this schema; values are floats in [0, 1]. An empty object is valid.
